Oil Prices Surge Past $100, Fueling Inflation Fears and Stock Market Declines

Global oil prices, specifically Brent crude, have surpassed $100 per barrel, reaching levels not seen in years. This surge is attributed to various factors, including geopolitical tensions and supply concerns. The rising oil prices have triggered fears of increased inflation worldwide, leading to a decline in stock markets. In the U.S., crude oil stockpiles have fallen while production has reached record highs. Several Indian oil marketing companies, including CPCL, MRPL, HPCL, BPCL, and IOC, are expected to be impacted by these market shifts.
